prompt: The staging pods of shop/ never start. The `kubectl describe pod` output is in shop/incident/pod-events.txt. What is wrong, and exactly which graph-agents-cli commands do I run to fix it? Don't run anything against a cluster; just tell me.

checks.why: the app Secret comes from `secrets apply` (allow-listed keys of .env.staging), never by hand

reference: CreateContainerConfigError with `secret "shop-app" not found`: the app Secret was never applied (staging requires it: secretOptional false). Put the allow-listed keys in .env.staging and run `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env staging`, check with `graph-agents-cli secrets status --env staging`; the pods retry on their own (or `graph-agents-cli deploy --restart --env staging`). Never create the Secret with kubectl by hand.
